Documentation

## Resources for Current Users

Access to our comprehensive documentation is limited to customers on Support.

![](https://opendental.com/site/images/helpAnimation.gif)

To access our documentation, launch Open Dental on your workstation. From any window, click the question mark icon (?) in the upper right. This will launch the corresponding [Help Page](https://opendental.com/site/helpfeature.html) and provide access to all available Help pages.

## Resources for Potential and Former Users

If you are considering Open Dental, or your office was formerly on Support, much of our documentation is private.

For a brief overview of our features, browse our public [Quick Manual](https://opendental.com/site/quickmanual.html).

## Resources for Developers

- Developers wanting to integrate with Open Dental should review our [API Specification](https://opendental.com/site/apispecification.html).
- Users curious about third-party integrations should review [Vendors - Supplemental Services and Products](https://opendental.com/site/vendorssupplementalservices.html).

## Resources for IT Professionals

- For general information, see [Advanced Topics](https://opendental.com/site/advancedtopics.html).
- For installing Open Dental, see [Installation](https://opendental.com/site/installation.html).
- For technical details, see [Network and Computer Setup](https://opendental.com/site/computernetworksetup.html).

## Additional Resources

- For contact details and helpful resources, see [Support](https://opendental.com/site/support.html).
- If using Open Dental outside of the U.S., review [International Customers](https://opendental.com/site/countries.html).
